params.name: status
params.description: Fetch only forms with this status.

params.name: page
params.description: Define which page to fetch, using the limit property to define how many items a page will contain. (0 indexed)

params.name: limit
params.description: Define how many items to include per page.

params.name: formTemplateId
params.description: Specify a form template ID to filter by.

params.name: finalizedAtFrom
params.description: Fetch forms with a finalizedAt date FROM the provided value as an ISO UTC string. Inclusive.

params.name: finalizedAtUntil
params.description: Fetch forms with a finalizedAt date UNTIL the provided value as an ISO UTC string. Inclusive.

params.name: sortField
params.description: Specify the field used for sorting.

params.name: sortDirection
params.description: Define the sort order of the received payload.

items.docs: Returns a paginated list of form instances the caller has access to. Supports filtering and sorting via query parameters.
Returns the details of a single form instance identified by its ID.
